# Environment variables

Generated from the source by `scripts/gen-reference.mjs`; do not edit by hand. The variables Nowaki reads, from `api/env.txt` (a scan of the code). Everything above the last section is covered by semver ([STABILITY.md](../STABILITY.md)). Variables the app declares itself go in `env.ts` ([runtime-env.md](runtime-env.md)).

The `nowaki` CLI also takes `NOWAKI_*` variables from the app's `.env` / `.env.local` files (a variable set in the environment wins), except `NOWAKI_HOST`: the listen address (`PORT`, `NOWAKI_HOST`) comes only from the environment or the flags.

## Listening and the site URL

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOWAKI_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` (`nowaki dev`, `nowaki start`); `0.0.0.0` (node / bun / deno adapter output) | Address to listen on. `--host <addr>` wins over it; `--host` alone listens on all interfaces (`0.0.0.0`). |
| `NOWAKI_SITE` | nowaki.config `site` | The site's absolute URL (`https://example.com`), used for canonical and Open Graph links, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt` and `ctx.site`. Wins over `site` in nowaki.config at runtime, on every server and adapter. |
| `NOWAKI_TRUST_PROXY` | unset (off) | `1` / `true` / `yes`: trust the `x-forwarded-host` / `x-forwarded-proto` / `x-forwarded-for` headers a reverse proxy sets, for the same-origin (CSRF) checks and the request URL. Set it only behind a proxy that overwrites those headers. Read by `nowaki start` and the node / bun / deno adapter output. |
| `PORT` | `3000` | Port every server listens on: `nowaki dev`, `nowaki start`, and the node / bun / deno adapter output (`dist/server/index.mjs`). `--port` wins over it. |

## Security

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOWAKI_CSP` | unset (off) | `report-only` sends `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only`, `enforce` sends `Content-Security-Policy`, both with a nonce that is new for every response, on the scripts and styles Nowaki emits and on tags written with `nonce()`. See [headers.md](headers.md#content-security-policy). |
| `NOWAKI_CSP_REPORT_URI` | unset | Adds `report-uri <value>` to the `NOWAKI_CSP` policy. |
| `NOWAKI_SECURITY_HEADERS` | on | `off` (or `0` / `false` / `no`) removes the [default security headers](headers.md#default-security-headers). |

## Sessions

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOWAKI_SESSION_SECRET` | none; `nowaki dev` generates `.nowaki/session-secret` | Key material for `ctx.session` cookies: at least 32 characters. Several values, comma-separated, rotate keys (the first encrypts or signs new cookies, every one is accepted). Production refuses to use a session without it. |

## Jetstream (live islands)

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOWAKI_LIVE_MAX` | `10000` | Most live (WebSocket) connections one server accepts at once; more get an `at capacity` error. |
| `NOWAKI_LIVE_MAX_AGE` | `86400` (24 h) | Seconds a signed live state stays valid. An older page gets `nowaki:live-stale` and reloads. |
| `NOWAKI_LIVE_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS` | `10000` | Milliseconds one live island render may take before the event fails. |
| `NOWAKI_LIVE_ROOMS_FILE` | `.nowaki/live-rooms.json` | File (relative to the app root) where `nowaki start` saves room state (`live.room` / `shared`) and loads it from on the next start; `off` disables it. |
| `NOWAKI_LIVE_SECRET` | a random key per process (warned) | Key that signs live island state. Set it in production so signatures stay valid across processes, instances and restarts. |

## ISR cache and revalidation

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOWAKI_ISR_MAX` | `1024` | Most entries the `nowaki start` ISR cache holds per process. |
| `NOWAKI_ISR_WARM` | on | `0` / `off` / `false` / `no` stops `nowaki start` from rendering every ISR page once in the background at startup. |
| `NOWAKI_REVALIDATE_SECRET` | unset (endpoint off) | Enables [`POST /__nowaki/revalidate`](endpoints.md#post-__nowakirevalidate), which purges ISR pages by path or tag with `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`. The endpoint answers 404 while it is unset. |

## Request body limits

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOWAKI_FN_BODY_LIMIT` | `1048576` (1 MiB) | Largest server function (`/__nowaki/fn`) request body, in bytes; a larger one gets 413. |
| `NOWAKI_FORM_BODY_LIMIT` | `10485760` (10 MiB) | Largest body `ctx.formData()`, `ctx.bodyText()` and `ctx.bodyJson()` read, in bytes; a larger one gets 413 before user code runs. |

## Logs, Server-Timing and tracing

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOWAKI_LOG` | plain text on stderr | `json` writes one JSON object per log line, with the fields `time`, `level`, `msg`, `source`, `trace_id` and `span_id`. |
| `NOWAKI_SERVER_TIMING` | off in production, on in `nowaki dev` | `1` / `true` / `yes` / `on` adds a `Server-Timing` header to responses. |

## OpenTelemetry

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OTEL_BSP_MAX_EXPORT_BATCH_SIZE` | `512` | Most spans in one export. |
| `OTEL_BSP_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE` | `2048` | Most spans waiting for export; more are dropped. |
| `OTEL_BSP_SCHEDULE_DELAY` | `5000` | Milliseconds between span exports. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | unset (tracing off) | OTLP/HTTP collector base URL; traces go to `<endpoint>/v1/traces`. Tracing is on when this or `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT` is set. The Rust front needs a plain `http://` URL (a local collector). |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` | unset | Headers sent to the collector, as `k1=v1,k2=v2` (values percent-decoded). |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT` | unset | Full traces URL; wins over `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_HEADERS` | unset | Like `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS`, for traces; wins over it. |
| `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED` | unset | `true` turns tracing off even with an endpoint set. |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` | `nowaki` | The `service.name` of exported spans. |
| `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER` | `parentbased_always_on` | `always_on`, `always_off`, `traceidratio`, `parentbased_always_on`, `parentbased_always_off` or `parentbased_traceidratio`. An unknown name is the default. |
| `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG` | `1` | The ratio (0 to 1) for the `traceidratio` samplers. |

## Cloudflare adapter

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` | unset | API token with the Cache Purge permission, for the zone purge (see `CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID`). Set it as a Worker secret. |
| `CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID` | unset | With `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, set on the Worker: `revalidatePath` / `revalidateTag` purge the zone by tag, in every data center. Without them only the local data center's cache is purged by path, and tags purge nothing. |

## Dev server and build conveniences (not covered by semver)

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOWAKI_DEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | unset | When `nowaki dev` listens beyond loopback: extra `Host` names it answers (comma-separated; `*` for any). IP addresses, `localhost`, `*.localhost` and `*.local` are always accepted. |
| `NOWAKI_EDITOR` | `vscode` | Where the dev toolbar's source links open: `vscode`, `code`, `vscode-insiders`, `cursor`, `windsurf`, `zed`, or a URL template with `{file}` (and optionally `{line}`, `{column}`). |
| `NOWAKI_HINTS` | on | `0` / `off` / `false` hides the "could be live" hints in the `nowaki build` report and the dev tools. |
| `NOWAKI_IMAGES_REFRESH` | off | `1` fetches remote `<Image>` sources again instead of using the cached copies. |
| `NOWAKI_TOOLBAR` | on | `0` / `off` / `false` keeps the dev toolbar out of pages under `nowaki dev` (same as `--no-toolbar`). |

## Not for apps

Internal (set by Nowaki for its own processes; may change in any release): `NOWAKI_CONTENT_OK`, `NOWAKI_DEV_ERROR`, `NOWAKI_ENV_OK`, `NOWAKI_EXIT_WITH_PARENT`, `NOWAKI_IMAGES_ALLOW_LOOPBACK_FOR_TESTS`, `NOWAKI_PLUGIN_HOST_READY`, `NOWAKI_PRERENDER`, `NOWAKI_PRERENDER_POOL_THRESHOLD`, `NOWAKI_PRERENDER_WORKERS`, `NOWAKI_PUBLISH_TOKEN`, `NOWAKI_RUST_PORT`, `NOWAKI_SIDECAR_READY`, `NOWAKI_SITE_CONFIG`, `NOWAKI_START_READY`.

Standard variables Nowaki also reads: `HOME`, `NODE_ENV`, `NO_COLOR`, `USERPROFILE`.
